sources.title: [2407.04620] Learning to (Learn at Test Time): RNNs with Expressive ...
sources.snippet: We consider two instantiations: TTT-Linear and TTT-MLP, whose hidden state is a linear model and a two-layer MLP respectively. We evaluate our instantiations at the scale of 125M to 1.3B parameters, comparing with a strong Transformer and Mamba, a modern RNN.
